title: The Saenchai Reset, for Smaller Fighters
sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by how Saenchai trains, not his exact program.
note: Saenchai won Lumpinee titles in four weight classes and often gave up weight to find opponents. He beat bigger men with timing and balance, not power.

items: Shadow. One small step off the line, then answer.
Let the kick pass, return yours.
Hold the leg out for 2 seconds.
Catch a light body kick, step out
Partner kicks light. Catch, step to the side, let go.
Catch, then push him off balance
Slow. Feel where his weight is.
Catch, then sweep the standing leg
On mats, slow, partner knows it's coming.
Shadow the catch and the sweep as one move.
Never stay where your combo ended.
One job: make him miss and start again.
